rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion narrow and institutional, emphasizing that §512(i) is a safe-harbor condition and that secondary liability requires actionable, subscriber-linked knowledge of specific infringements rather than notice volume. Separate concurrences are most likely from Thomas/Gorsuch (limits on judge-made secondary liability and textual structure) and Jackson/Sotomayor (procedural-fairness and over-termination concerns), with Alito possibly adding a cautionary gloss on willful blindness.
